prose: Oracle has scrapped a roughly $7 billion, five-year deal to lease about 100,000 advanced AI chips to Tencent after yielding to pressure from the Trump administration, per Financial Times sources. It reflects tension for US AI infrastructure groups doing business with Chinese tech giants.
highlights: Oracle cancelled a ~$7B, five-year lease of ~100K AI chips to Tencent
Reported as yielding to Trump administration pressure, per FT sources
basis: Error cache: FT paywall. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
